title.en: Game of Thrones Character Test

description.en: Take 18 original model-village questions to explore six Game of Thrones characters. Read every highest tie and all complete guides free. Unofficial fan quiz.
description.zh: 用18道原创模型村落情境题，探索琼恩、提利昂、艾莉亚、珊莎、丹妮莉丝和詹姆六位角色。最高并列完整保留，所有结果与计数说明免费可读。非官方电视剧同人测验，不考剧情。

seoTitle.en: Game of Thrones Character Test: Six Free Results
seoTitle.zh: 权力的游戏角色测试：18题与六种完整结果

resultHeading.en: Your Game of Thrones character readings
resultHeading.zh: 本次《权力的游戏》人物读法

introduction.en: Which Game of Thrones character do your voluntary creative choices bring to mind? Imagine friends making an entirely original, peaceful paper village: keeping a chosen commitment, reframing with kind wit, practising a technique, adapting a presentation, imagining a wider possibility or revising an earlier choice. This independent TV fan edition contains 18 original situations and six complete public guides available before you start. No plot recall, combat, political strategy or moral judgement is required.
introduction.zh: 自愿创作选择让你想到《权力的游戏》的哪位人物？想象朋友做完全原创、和平纸村落：留清自选承诺、友好机智重述、练手法、调呈现、想大可能或改早先选择。本独立电视剧同人版有18原创情境和六份开测前可读全文，不需记剧情、战斗、政治策略或道德判断。

instructions.en: Think about a small, optional model-making or creative activity you would enjoy now. Choose one of four responses for every situation, even if none fits perfectly. There is no correct answer or ranking of people’s worth. A character absent from an item is not rejected. Finish all 18 choices before counts appear; every highest tie receives a complete guide.
instructions.zh: 想象现在愿参加的小型可选模型、创作活动，每情境四选一，即使都不完美。无正确答案，不排名人的价值；当题没出现者不算被拒绝。18题选完才出次数，每个最高并列都有全文。

prompt.en: Friends are making an entirely original, peaceful model village. What would you most enjoy contributing first?
prompt.zh: 朋友做一个完全原创、和平的模型村落，你最喜欢先贡献什么？

label.en: Choose a modest agreed task and make sure the group knows I will handle it.
label.zh: 选一项约好的小任务，让小组知道自己会做。

label.en: Offer an amusing rephrasing that helps everyone see the village idea differently.
label.zh: 用有趣新说法，让大家换个角度看村落点子。

label.en: Practise one small model-making technique in my own way before adding a piece.
label.zh: 先按自己方式练一项模型小手法，再添作品。

label.en: Notice how the different makers want their pieces introduced to visitors.
label.zh: 注意不同制作者想怎样向访客介绍作品。

prompt.en: The village project has become stuck on the way an idea is being described. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 村落项目卡在一个点子怎样描述上，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Try a witty but kind comparison that makes the idea easier to discuss.
label.zh: 试一个机智友好比喻，让点子好讨论。

label.en: Make a small practice piece so I can explore the idea directly.
label.zh: 做小练习件，直接探索点子。

label.en: Ask what presentation format would help each person feel understood.
label.zh: 问怎样呈现，让各人感觉被理解。

label.en: Imagine a wider version of the village that opens another creative possibility.
label.zh: 想村落更大一个版本，打开另一创作可能。

prompt.en: You can learn one harmless paper technique for your own village piece. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 可以为自己的村落作品学一种无害纸手法，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Try it repeatedly in a small self-chosen exercise.
label.zh: 在自选小练习里反复试。

label.en: Watch how different people explain it and choose a format that suits the exchange.
label.zh: 看不同人怎样解释，选适合交流的形式。

label.en: Picture what a much more imaginative structure could look like using it.
label.zh: 想用它能做什么更有想象的建筑。

label.en: Revisit my earlier plan if this technique suggests a better small choice.
label.zh: 若手法带来更好小选择，重看早先计划。

prompt.en: The model village will be shown to friends with different interests. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 模型村落要给不同兴趣朋友看，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Adapt the introduction so different visitors can find an approachable starting point.
label.zh: 调整介绍，让不同访客找到好进入的起点。

label.en: Describe an inviting larger vision of what the village could become.
label.zh: 描述村落可能长成怎样的、有吸引力的大画面。

label.en: Change an earlier display decision if the new audience makes it less useful.
label.zh: 若新访客让早先陈列决定不好用，就改。

label.en: Complete the particular preparation task I agreed to do.
label.zh: 完成自己约好做的那项准备。

prompt.en: A blank corner of the model could become almost anything. What would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 模型一个空角几乎能做成任何东西，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: Imagine a generous new possibility that changes how the whole village feels.
label.zh: 想一个宽广新可能，改变整个村落感觉。

label.en: Consider whether an earlier choice should change to make room for the new idea.
label.zh: 考虑早先选择是否应改，给新点子位置。

label.en: Keep the existing agreed tasks clear while the group explores the extra.
label.zh: 小组探额外部分时，仍说清已有约定任务。

label.en: Find a playful name or comparison that makes the strange idea understandable.
label.zh: 找趣味名字、比喻，让奇特点子好懂。

prompt.en: A first attempt at your village piece does not fit the shared model. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 自己的村落作品首稿不合共同模型，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Revise the earlier choice openly rather than defend it just because it was mine.
label.zh: 公开修早先选择，不因是自己的就守着。

label.en: Check which agreed responsibility still needs to be completed.
label.zh: 核还有哪项约定责任要完成。

label.en: Use a lighthearted reframing to make discussing the mismatch less awkward.
label.zh: 轻松换个说法，让讨论不合处少尴尬。

label.en: Practise the specific technique again on a smaller piece.
label.zh: 用更小物件再练具体手法。

prompt.en: Several optional village details are waiting to be made. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 几项可选村落细节等着做，你更愿意怎样选？

label.en: Take one task I genuinely agree to finish and leave the rest for discussion.
label.zh: 接一项真同意做完的，其他再讨论。

label.en: Suggest a humorous organising idea that makes the details easier to talk about.
label.zh: 提一个幽默组织点子，让细节好聊。

label.en: Choose a detail that gives me a useful small technique to practise.
label.zh: 选一个能练有用小手法的细节。

label.en: Ask how the details will be presented so different contributions are visible.
label.zh: 问细节怎样展示，让不同贡献看得见。

prompt.en: Two makers describe the same peaceful model scene in very different terms. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 两制作者用很不同说法描述同一个和平模型场景，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Find a kind, playful phrase that helps them notice the common idea.
label.zh: 找友好趣味说法，让双方看见共同点子。

label.en: Build a tiny sample in my own practice space to see what each version involves.
label.zh: 在自己练习空间做微小样例，看看两版涉及什么。

label.en: Give each person a suitable way to explain their version before comparing.
label.zh: 给各人合适解释方式，再比较。

label.en: Imagine a broader layout where both ideas might create something new.
label.zh: 想更广布局，让两点子合出新东西。

prompt.en: Your paper-building technique is improving, but the next step is uncertain. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 纸建筑手法在进步，下一步却不确定，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Choose a manageable practice variation and learn from the attempt.
label.zh: 选可做的练习变式，从尝试学。

label.en: Ask which explanation or feedback format would be easiest to use.
label.zh: 问哪种解释、反馈形式最容易用。

label.en: Picture an ambitious but optional design the technique might eventually support.
label.zh: 想一个手法以后可能支持的、有想象但可选的设计。

label.en: Update the first plan if the practice has shown a better direction.
label.zh: 若练习显出更好方向，就更新首计划。

prompt.en: Friends are choosing how to walk visitors through their handmade village. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 朋友选怎样带访客看手工村落，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Notice who wants a short overview and who would enjoy a detailed explanation.
label.zh: 留意谁想短总览、谁喜欢细解释。

label.en: Offer an inspiring picture of the whole imaginary village before the details.
label.zh: 细节前给整个想象村落的、启发人的画面。

label.en: Change the planned route if visitors’ actual interests suggest another order.
label.zh: 若访客实际兴趣不同，就改预定路线。

label.en: Make sure the agreed setup task is ready before the visit.
label.zh: 访客来前备好约定布置任务。

prompt.en: The group can imagine a bigger village but has not decided whether to build it. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 小组想出更大村落，还没决定是否制作，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Explore the larger possibility as an invitation, without treating it as a promise.
label.zh: 把大可能当邀请探索，不当承诺。

label.en: Review what would need to change in the current plan before choosing.
label.zh: 选择前重看现计划要改什么。

label.en: Keep the existing commitments separate from the optional expansion.
label.zh: 分清已有承诺与可选扩展。

label.en: Use a playful comparison that makes the ambitious idea easier to picture.
label.zh: 用趣味比喻，让大点子好想象。

prompt.en: Someone offers a useful correction to a choice you made early in the project. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 有人对项目早先自己选择提有用修正，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Acknowledge the correction and choose what to change now.
label.zh: 认可修正，选现在改什么。

label.en: Check how the change affects the task I already agreed to finish.
label.zh: 核改变怎样影响已约做完的任务。

label.en: Reframe the mistake lightly without making anyone the target of a joke.
label.zh: 轻松重述失误，不把人当笑话目标。

label.en: Practise the corrected small step before returning to the shared model.
label.zh: 回共同模型前，先练修正后小步骤。

prompt.en: The village session is shorter than expected. What would you most like to preserve?
prompt.zh: 村落活动比预期短，你最想保留什么？

label.en: The clear, bounded task I genuinely promised to complete.
label.zh: 自己真承诺完成的清楚、有范围任务。

label.en: A light and useful way for the group to discuss the changed plan.
label.zh: 一个轻松有用的说法，让小组讨论变后计划。

label.en: A little self-chosen practice that still feels worth trying.
label.zh: 仍值得试的一点自选练习。

label.en: A way to present the contributions people have already made.
label.zh: 一个展示大家已做贡献的办法。

prompt.en: The model’s invented village name sounds grander than the makers intended. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 模型虚构村名听起来比制作者原意宏大，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Find a witty alternative that keeps the charm while making the scale clear.
label.zh: 找机智替代，留趣味，也说清规模。

label.en: Try lettering the name in a small practice piece before deciding.
label.zh: 决定前，用小练习件试村名字样。

label.en: Ask which name fits how the group wants to introduce its work.
label.zh: 问哪名字合小组想怎样介绍作品。

label.en: Imagine whether the grand name could inspire an optional future design.
label.zh: 想大名字是否启发一个可选未来设计。

prompt.en: You can improve one small part of your own handmade building. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 能改进自己手工建筑一个小部分，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Practise a chosen detail until I understand what changes its appearance.
label.zh: 练选定细节，弄懂什么改变外观。

label.en: Choose a feedback format that makes another person’s observation easy to use.
label.zh: 选反馈形式，让别人观察好用。

label.en: Use the detail as a starting point for a much more imaginative building.
label.zh: 把细节当更有想象建筑的起点。

label.en: Let a better new option replace the design I first preferred.
label.zh: 让更好新选项替代最初偏爱设计。

prompt.en: Visitors misunderstand why two very different pieces sit together. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 访客误解两个很不同作品为何放一起，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Change the explanation to suit the question they are actually asking.
label.zh: 按实际在问的问题，改解释。

label.en: Describe the wider imagined world that gives the two pieces a connection.
label.zh: 描述让两件相连的、更大想象世界。

label.en: Revise the arrangement if the first layout is no longer serving the work.
label.zh: 若首布局不再服务作品，就改。

label.en: Finish the agreed label or setup change that the group chooses.
label.zh: 完成小组选择的、已约标签或布置改变。

prompt.en: A friend suggests a whole new peaceful district for the paper village. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 朋友建议给纸村落加一个全新和平街区，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Explore the generous creative possibility before reducing it to a task list.
label.zh: 变任务清单前，先探索宽广创意可能。

label.en: Ask which earlier decisions would need revisiting if the group chose it.
label.zh: 问若采用，要重看哪些早先决定。

label.en: Keep clear what is optional and what people have actually agreed to make.
label.zh: 分清可选与实际同意制作的部分。

label.en: Offer a playful description that helps everyone picture the new district.
label.zh: 给趣味描述，让人人能想象新街区。

prompt.en: At the end, the group notices that an early model choice should change next time. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 收尾时小组发现早先模型选择下次该改，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Record the revised choice without treating the first attempt as something to hide.
label.zh: 记修后选择，不把首试当需隐藏的事。

label.en: Clarify the one follow-up task I am genuinely willing to take.
label.zh: 说清真愿意接的一项后续任务。

label.en: Use a kind humorous recap that makes learning from the change easier.
label.zh: 用友好幽默回顾，让从变化学习更容易。

label.en: Choose a small practice exercise that could prepare the next version.
label.zh: 选一个为下版准备的小练习。

description.en: Read Jon Snow's chosen-commitment angle through one model-making task. Compare six characters and try an agreement with a clear finish and room to revise.
description.zh: 村落模型的任务做不完时，怎样说清自己愿意接的那一项？阅读琼恩的自选承诺角度、六角色比较和计数解释，试着约定完成条件与调整办法，不把一项任务变成全部责任。

scoreReading.en: Complete all 18 situations. Every explicitly mapped choice adds one raw count to one of six characters, making 18 counts in total. Each character appears 12 times, three times in each option position; an absent character is not rejected. Every highest count receives a complete guide. All A gives three counts each and a six-way tie. These counts describe choices in this original bank, not match percentages, norms, morality, political views, professional competence or validated personality differences.
scoreReading.zh: 完成18情境，每项明确映射选择给六人物中一位加一次原始次数，总计18次。每人物出现12次、每位置3次；没出现者不算被拒绝。所有最高获全文；全选A各3次、六方并列。次数描述本原创题本，不是匹配百分比、常模、道德、政治、职业能力或经验证人格差异。

title.en: Jon’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Jon Snow is one of this edition’s six selected television characters. The editorial angle here is a clear, freely chosen commitment in a peaceful model-making hobby. It does not measure honour, obedience, courage, leadership or willingness to sacrifice yourself. A modest task can matter without becoming an oath. You may decline, renegotiate or stop a voluntary contribution rather than treating a fictional character’s responsibilities as instructions for your life.
paragraphs.zh: 琼恩·雪诺是本版选定六位电视剧人物之一。本版编辑角度是和平模型爱好中清楚、自选的承诺，不测荣誉、服从、勇气、领导或牺牲意愿。小任务可有意义，不必成誓言；可拒绝、重商量或停自愿贡献，不把虚构职责当生活指令。

title.en: One task instead of every unfinished detail
title.zh: 一项任务，不是所有未完细节

paragraphs.en: Friends have more village-model ideas than time. You choose one task you genuinely agree to finish and make the stopping point clear. The group can plan around that actual offer while discussing the remaining optional details. Your contribution is not more worthy because it is difficult or invisible, and taking one task does not silently make you responsible for the whole miniature village.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友村落模型点子比时间多。你选真同意做完的一项，说清停点，让安排据实际提供，余下可选再聊。贡献不因难、隐形就更值得，也不因接一项就默默负责整个村落。

title.en: Commitment beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Tyrion reframes an idea with kind humour, Arya practises a chosen technique and Sansa adapts the introduction. Daenerys imagines a wider possibility while Jaime revisits an earlier choice. Jon’s selected angle makes one commitment understandable. These can support a peaceful hobby together without ranking loyalty, goodness or who should lead. A tied reading does not create competing duties or ask you to prove which fictional allegiance is real.
paragraphs.zh: 提利昂友好幽默重述，艾莉亚练自选手法，珊莎调介绍；丹妮莉丝想大可能，詹姆重看早先选择。琼恩角度让承诺好懂。可共助和平爱好，不评忠诚、好坏、谁该带领；并列不制造竞争义务，也不要求证明虚构效忠。

title.en: A commitment can be revised openly

paragraphs.en: If the agreed task becomes impractical, say what has changed and discuss a smaller contribution. Finishing everything is not the only honest outcome. Other people can make their own offers too. A high count cannot establish rigidity, self-sacrifice or moral superiority, while a lower count does not prove unreliability, selfishness or an inability to cooperate. The reading stays within the choices offered in this particular bank.
paragraphs.zh: 任务不实际时，说变了什么，讨论小些贡献。诚实结果不只做完全部；别人也可自选提供。高计数不确立僵化、牺牲或道德更高，低计数不证明不可靠、自私、不能合作；读法留在这份题本选择内。

title.en: Try one agreement with a stopping point
title.zh: 试一个有停止点的约定

paragraphs.en: For an optional model-making session, name one task you want to take, its finish condition and a simple way to revise it. Tell the group before beginning. Afterwards, compare the agreement with what actually happened. This gives feedback on one shared arrangement, not a character test of honour, a leadership score or a reason to accept more responsibility than you want.
paragraphs.zh: 可选模型活动说一项愿接任务、完成条件、容易改法，开前告诉小组，之后比约定与实际。这反馈共同安排，不是荣誉考验、领导分数，也不成为接过多责任的理由。

title.en: Eighteen choices and every highest tie

paragraphs.en: Complete all 18 situations. Every explicitly mapped choice adds one raw count to one of six characters, making 18 counts in total. Each character appears 12 times, three times in each option position; an absent character is not rejected. Every highest count receives a complete guide. All A gives three counts each and a six-way tie. These counts describe choices in this original bank, not match percentages, norms, morality, political views, professional competence or validated personality differences.
paragraphs.zh: 完成18情境，每项明确映射选择给六人物中一位加一次原始次数，总计18次。每人物出现12次、每位置3次；没出现者不算被拒绝。所有最高获全文；全选A各3次、六方并列。次数描述本原创题本，不是匹配百分比、常模、道德、政治、职业能力或经验证人格差异。

title.en: Original fan edition and source limits
title.zh: 原创同人版与来源边界

paragraphs.en: FermatMind independently authored this unofficial TV fan edition: original questions, mappings, examples and complete readings. The linked distributor cast list supplies basic character names only; it does not validate these angles or this bank. Names belong to their respective rights holders. No show images, dialogue, episode scenes, novel passages or competitor questions and reports are reproduced. This is a selective entertainment comparison without affiliation or scientific validation, not a judgement of political beliefs, morality, trauma, diagnosis, dangerousness or professional ability.
paragraphs.zh: 费马独立创作本非官方电视剧同人版的题目、映射、例子和全文。所链发行方名单只支持基本人物名称，不验证角度或题本。名称属于各权利方；不复用剧照、台词、剧情场景、小说段落、竞品题目或报告。本版为选择性娱乐比较，无合作、科学验证，不判断政治、道德、创伤、诊断、危险或职业能力。

title.zh: 不同访客也许要不同开场

paragraphs.en: Friends will show the handmade village to visitors with varied interests. You notice who wants a quick overview and who would enjoy a maker explaining one detailed piece. Offering different starting points can make the display easier to explore. It need not involve guessing private feelings, flattering someone or deciding that a visitor with less knowledge deserves a simpler or less interesting experience.

title.en: Adaptation does not require self-erasure

paragraphs.en: Ask what format would help instead of assuming you know what everyone wants. You can offer a short version, a drawing or a detailed explanation while keeping your own limits visible. A high count cannot establish conformity, manipulation or exceptional empathy, while a lower count does not mean social ignorance or indifference. The quiz cannot tell you how to manage a real conflict or what another person secretly expects.

title.zh: 试两种同样尊重的介绍

paragraphs.en: For an optional creative display, prepare a short overview and one more detailed explanation. Ask a willing visitor which they would enjoy, then let their choice guide the format. Afterwards, ask whether it helped them explore the work. This is feedback on a presentation, not a measure of social intelligence, a judgement of status or an instruction to adapt yourself to every audience.

title.en: A new district can begin as an invitation

paragraphs.en: An empty corner of the handmade village suggests a whole peaceful district the group has not considered. You describe the possibility before reducing it to individual tasks. Friends may enjoy the imagined version without agreeing to build it. The idea can stay small, become a sketch or be set aside; its value does not depend on persuading everyone to accept an ambitious expansion.

title.en: Vision beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Jon keeps chosen commitments clear, Tyrion makes an idea discussable and Arya explores a technique. Sansa adapts the introduction while Jaime updates the first plan. title.en: A vision needs other people’s actual choices
title.zh: 愿景需要别人的实际选择

paragraphs.en: Keep imagination separate from agreement. Ask whether people want the larger version, what effort it would require and what they would freely contribute. A smaller design may serve the group better. A high count cannot establish grandiosity, idealism or exceptional inspiration, while a lower count does not mean pessimism, timidity or a lack of imagination. No score establishes a right to direct other people’s work.
paragraphs.zh: 分想象与同意。问想不想大版、要多少投入、各人自愿给什么；小设计也许更好。高计数不确立夸大、理想主义或超强启发，低计数不表示悲观、胆小、没想象。分数不赋指挥别人工作的权利。

title.en: Try a vision and its smallest version
title.zh: 试愿景与它的最小版本

paragraphs.en: For a harmless creative idea, sketch a larger possibility and the smallest version someone could enjoy now. Present both as optional and invite changes before making a task list. Notice what the group actually chooses. This is feedback on an invitation to imagine, not a leadership assessment, a political recommendation or evidence that your idea should outrank someone else’s limits.
